title: Unified failure classification and dashboards for RPC and model faults
creator: Ethan Zhao
description: Background: Our current error dashboards are fragmented across services and mix HTTP/gRPC responses, runtime model faults, and gateway-level timeouts. Engineers spend time manually correlating logs, spans, and model traces when investigating production incidents. Goal: define a small, pragmatic failure taxonomy that covers timeouts, overload, model/runtime errors, and protocol status codes, instrument the runtime and gateway with consistent span attributes and error tags, and produce a pair of Grafana dashboards (errors + latency) that let oncall/product engineers triage by failure type, model variant, and route.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical failure taxonomy documented in Confluence with canonical keys: TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_ERROR, PROTOCOL_ERROR, TRANSIENT_NET, AUTHZ, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE
Runtime and gateway emit standardized span attributes for every request: failure_type, failure_code, model.name, model.version, route, deployment_tier
Log/metric pipeline parses failure_type and normalizes HTTP/gRPC codes into protocol_status and protocol_family (4xx/5xx/gRPC-14 etc)
Errors dashboard shows: failures/sec broken down by failure_type and model.name, top offending routes, and recent example traces with links to Jaeger/OpenTelemetry
Latency dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for overall and per failure_type, plus queue length, GPU_util, and request_size heatmap
Alerting runbooks created linking to dashboards and automated follow-up issues for persistent regressions
Docs and examples in the SDK for instrumenting custom backends with the same tags
implementation_notes: Trace hooks: instrument SDK middleware to attach model metadata early (model.name/model.version/request_seq_len) so traces correlate model errors to sequence length patterns
Metrics: increment counter 'inference.failures' with labels: failure_type, model, route, customer_tier. Histogram 'inference.latency' labeled by failure_type and model
Log pipeline: update parsing rules in Logstash/Fluentd to map HTTP status -> PROTOCOL_ERROR and gRPC codes -> PROTOCOL_ERROR with code tag. Enrich with upstream_node and shard_id for Dedicated
Dashboards: two Grafana panels (Errors Overview, Latency & Saturation). Use Loki for recent error log samples with trace_id links.
Trade-offs: keep taxonomy intentionally coarse to avoid combinatorial explosion. Start with 6 buckets; may add 'QUOTA' or 'AUTHZ' later if telemetry shows distinct patterns
Rollout: synthetic traffic test (canary) -> internal prod subset -> global rollout. Add feature flag to toggle enriched spans if performance impact observed
